description: Calculate parcel preparation hours and average capacity needs from parcels, minutes per parcel, other work and available productive hours. It does not model shifts, concurrency, learning curves, carrier cutoffs or the actual daily workload distribution. Check peaks before sizing resources. It does not estimate payroll savings or recommend hiring or dismissal. Freed founder hours do not automatically represent cash savings. Input fields: parcels: An order shipped in two boxes counts as two parcels. minutesPerParcel: Measure picking, packing and labelling without double counting the next field. otherMinutes: Receipts, inventory checks and work excluded above. 0 if absent. workingDays: The average does not represent campaign peaks. productiveHours: Optional. Time available for all scenario tasks after breaks and unrelated duties. Blank means no staffing estimate.
name: calculate_picking_workload
title: Ecommerce picking and packing workload calculator
